patches_added.name: Discord Rich Presence
patches_added.description: Shows what you are doing on chess.com in Discord, from this phone alone: a game, a review or a puzzle, and how long you have been on. The account is connected once in Discord's own browser page, so no password and no computer are involved. Discord shows the activity under this bundle's Discord application name and keeps the status picked in the settings while the phone is connected. Runs by default and can be switched off in Quwi's Patches.
